units: synthetic contrast MSE; sigma ratio is standard deviation,variance factor=ratio squared
rules: Known true covariance shape retained,only scalar variance in SURE changed. Filters/calibrations/output/residual/directional samples remain FROZEN. Five predeclared sigma ratios .75/.9/1/1.1/1.25,4/8 probes. Parent nominal estimates reproduced before replay. Truth evaluates choices,never chooses score parameters. Best fixed reference determined descriptively on full same synthetic population,not prospective policy.
limitations: Sensitivity of risk DECISION only,not effect of erroneous calibration on denoising filters. Does not assess covariance-shape error,non-Gaussian RAW noise,epsilon convergence or full production pipeline. Repeated observations shared across all ratios;no independent final validation. No preferred variance chosen from true risks.
